context:
Goal: the native masthead shows on every tab, as on the web, and each tab's accessibility check runs.
Problem: on 2026-10-21 you let the Packages check ignore problems Apple's own tab bar raises, since we can't fix Apple's bar. Step 5 adds the same check to three more tabs under that same bar. Your ruling named Packages only, so extending it needs your word.
Based on: your 2026-10-21 ruling, the tab-bar skip on Packages (ruling).
Based on: step 5's tests at commit 3043852 already use the same skip (read).
Meanwhile: step 5's builder writes code and runs the checks that need no simulator. These three checks wait.
holds: Step 5's accessibility checks on Ledger, Orphaned and Tally cannot run green.

options.gain: Each tab is checked the same way, for the same reason.
options.how: Ledger, Orphaned and Tally ignore only the system tab bar's own problems, as Packages does. Every other check stays on.
options.label: Extend the skip to all tabs
options.lose: Three more checks ignore the tab bar strip.

options.how: The three new checks run in full, tab bar included.
options.label: Run those checks with no skip
options.lose: They will likely fail on Apple's tab bar, which we can't fix, so step 5 can't show a passing run.

ref: your 2026-10-21 ruling (tab-bar skip, Packages only); step 5, the masthead on every tab
title: Extend the iOS tab-bar skip to the Ledger, Orphaned and Tally accessibility checks?
why: It's the same reason you already accepted for Packages, on the same Apple bar.
